data.case_title: Housing benefit (Wohngeld) decision for Ronny Musterspree
data.explanation: The housing benefit office (Wohngeldstelle) of Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße has approved a monthly rent subsidy (Mietzuschuss) of €226 for 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, based on three household members and a gross cold rent of €690. Because your employer announced more working hours from January, the office wants your November and December 2026 payslips by 11 January 2027 to check if the amount needs to change — send them in good time, or your benefit could be recalculated incorrectly. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this. Keep the benefit decision for your records; no action is otherwise required to keep receiving the monthly payment.

items.title: Submit November and December 2026 payslips
items.action: Send copies of your November and December 2026 payslips (Lohnabrechnungen) to the Wohngeldstelle.
items.consequence: The office will check whether your increased working hours change the amount of your housing benefit.
items.quote: Legen Sie uns bitte bis zum 11.01.2027 die Lohnabrechnungen für November und Dezember 2026 vor, damit wir prüfen können, ob sich das Wohngeld ändert.

items.title: Monthly housing benefit (Mietzuschuss)
items.action: No action needed; the subsidy is paid monthly for the approved period.

date.text: für den genannten Zeitraum ... im Monat

items.quote: auf Ihren Antrag bewilligen wir Ihnen für den genannten Zeitraum einen Mietzuschuss von 226,00 € im Monat.

items.title: Housing benefit period ends
items.action: Apply for a follow-on Wohngeld decision before the period ends if you still need support.
items.consequence: Payments stop after this date unless a new approval is issued.
items.quote: Bescheid über Wohngeld für die Zeit vom 01.12.2026 bis 30.11.2027

items.title: Decide whether to object (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision with the Wohngeldstelle if you disagree with it.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline shown, the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

date.text: innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids

items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße, Amtsplatz 3, 15848 Beispielkow); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.

data.summary: The Wohngeldstelle of Landkreis Musterspree-Neiße approved Ronny Musterspree a monthly housing benefit (Mietzuschuss) of €226 for 1 December 2026 to 30 November 2027, based on three household members and a gross cold rent of €690. The office asks for his November and December 2026 payslips by 11 January 2027 to review the amount after an announced increase in working hours, and explains how to file an objection (Widerspruch) if he disagrees with the decision.
